request.style: English, male solo baritone voice, harp, bodhran, Celtic fiddle, flute, ambient pads, solemn and majestic mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Solomon conscripted laborers from all Israel
Thirty thousand men in all counted the roll
Sent to Lebanon in shifts of ten thousand
One month away two months at home in the soil

[Chorus]
Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor
Supervising the work with a heavy hand
Seventy thousand carrying loads on the mountain
Eighty thousand quarrying stone in the land

[Verse]
Three thousand three hundred foremen stood in charge
Overseeing the project and the workers below
At the king's command they quarried huge blocks
Costly dressed stone for the foundation of God's house

[Chorus]
Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor
Supervising the work with a heavy hand
Seventy thousand carrying loads on the mountain
Eighty thousand quarrying stone in the land

[Bridge]
Solomon's builders and Hiram's men joined together
With the men of Gebal cutting and shaping the stone
Preparing the timber for the temple of the Lord
Building the house as the king commanded to show

[Outro]
Cut and shaped them for the temple's glory
Prepared the stone for the Lord's holy ground
